scheme_name: Scheme for Establishment of Backyard Poultry Units
other_conditions: No mandatory educational qualifications or training requirements are specified.
Applicants who have previously availed benefits under any Departmental Scheme for the establishment of a livestock unit are ineligible.
Any unemployed person desirous of establishing backyard poultry may apply.
benefits_summary: Each beneficiary family receives 50 day‑old chicks along with two feeders and two drinkers delivered free to their doorstep.
